description: Election Communication - Order under 2023 Selection 03 of the Regulation of Election Expenditure Act, No. 03 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes for the 2024 Presidential Election, including expenditure limits for candidates, reporting requirements, and regulations governing campaign financing. It is issued by the Election Commission under the Regulation of Election Expenditure Act and contains detailed rules about election propaganda activities, expenditure reporting, and donation restrictions - all core electoral matters that fit Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
